captions.detailed: A compact, retro-style boutique cash register featuring a light gray main body with a sloped front console. It includes a sliding black cash drawer at the front base with a dark handle, a 3x4 grid of white numeric keys, a separate column of four orange function keys, and a small dark-framed customer display screen at the top rear. The cash drawer slides forward prismatically, the customer display flips up on a rear hinge, and the keys are designed to depress vertically.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated boutique cash register with a light gray sloped chassis, a sliding black front drawer, a 3x4 grid of white numeric keys, a column of orange function keys, and a rotatable customer display screen at the rear.
captions.factory: Construct the main body chassis using a Box primitive with chamfered upper front edges to form the sloped console. Create the sliding drawer as a separate dark-colored Box with a small handle, connected via a prismatic joint. Model the 3x4 numeric keypad and the single column of orange function keys as arrays of small boxes, each linked via vertical prismatic joints. Add a rear customer display consisting of a thin display screen and frame, mounted via a revolute joint to flip up at the back.
